$comment: Add TLS edge termination to AMQ Console routes. Operator creates wconsj routes without TLS; resourceTemplates patches them with edge termination so the router uses the cert-manager wildcard cert.

criteria.target: helm template . --values values.yaml --show-only templates/hub-broker.yaml 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'termination: edge'
criteria.$comment: hub-broker template renders with TLS edge termination in resourceTemplates

criteria.target: helm template . --values values.yaml --show-only templates/edge-broker.yaml 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'termination: edge'
criteria.$comment: edge-broker template renders with TLS edge termination in resourceTemplates

criteria.target: helm template . --values values.yaml --show-only templates/hub-broker.yaml 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'insecureEdgeTerminationPolicy: Redirect'
